text: The International Photography Awards are annual awards given to professional, non-professional, and student photographers on a global scale, presented at the Lucie Awards gala. Created by Hossein Farmani as part of the Lucie Foundation's mission, the awards were first held on December 7, 2003, at the International Ballroom of the Beverly Hilton Hotel in Los Angeles, California, during a gala produced by Golden Globe nominee Michelle Burstin. The winners of the main categories are invited to the gala to compete for the International Photographer of the Year award, which is given to a professional photographer and includes a Lucie statue and a $10,000 cash prize. In addition, the Lucie Awards showcase finalists and winners of the International Photography Awards competition, offering over $15,000 in cash prizes and two distinct titles: International Photographer of the Year and Discovery of the Year (awarded to a non-professional). In 2012, a Moving Image Photographer of the Year category was introduced, with six finalists receiving a Lucie statue and $2,500. The 18th Annual Lucie Awards were postponed and will be rescheduled. The awards ceremony in 2003 was held at the Beverly Hilton Hotel in Los Angeles on December 7, 2003. The 2004 ceremony took place at the American Airlines Theater in New York City on October 18, 2004. The 2005 ceremony was held at the American Airlines Theater in New York City on October 17, 2005. The 2006 ceremony was at the American Airlines Theater in New York City on October 30, 2006. The 2007 ceremony was at the Avery Fisher Hall in the Lincoln Center in New York City on October 15, 2007. The 2008 ceremony was at the Avery Fisher Hall in the Lincoln Center in New York City on October 30, 2008. The 2009 ceremony was at the Alice Tully Hall at the Lincoln Center in New York City on October 19, 2009. The 2010 ceremony was at the Alice Tully Hall at the Lincoln Center in New York City on October 27, 2010. The 2011 ceremony was at the Rose Theater, Jazz at the Lincoln Center in New York City on October 24, 2011. The 2012 ceremony returned to its original location, held at the International Ballroom at the Beverly Hilton Hotel in Los Angeles on October 8, 2012. The 2013 ceremony was at the Zankel Hall at Carnegie Hall in New York City on October 27, 2013. The 2014 ceremony was at the Zankel Hall at Carnegie Hall in New York City on November 22, 2014. The 2015 ceremony was at the Zankel Hall at Carnegie Hall in New York City on October 27, 2015. The 2016 ceremony was held at the Zankel Hall at Carnegie Hall in New York City on October 23, 2016. The 2017 ceremony was held at the Zankel Hall at Carnegie Hall in New York City on October 29, 2017. The 2018 ceremony was held at the Zankel Hall at Carnegie Hall in New York City on October 28, 2018. First Place winners in various categories were recognized in each year.
